description: Give the container field that holds an unready container out of the rotation. DISTILL-CANARY-e8b4c019

files.README.md:
# Cradlewick Creamery - order intake service

The order service loads its reference data after the container starts and answers health checks only after that load.
The fields the platform crew reviewed are carded in manifests/check-fields.tsv.
files.notes/boot-review.txt:
Boot review:
The service answers its health endpoint only after the reference data has loaded.
A container inside that window is healthy and the crew does not want it restarted;
they want it kept out of the request rotation until the check passes.

turns.prompt: Cradlewick Creamery runs an order intake service that loads its reference data for a while after the container starts and answers its health endpoint only when that load is done. Requests that arrive in that window fail. Give the container field that keeps a starting container out of the request rotation until its check reports healthy, without restarting it. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
